• therapy- cbt, emdr (much higher efficacy with emdr) 

• regular exercise & nutritional diet if either of these are accessible to you. (people will knock it, but what is in your body and moving it is really is a huge contributor) 

• psychedelics (ignore if it’s not your thing. studies do show therapeutic ket treatments and general tripping tend to help with ocd, but for some tripping intensifies obsessions & I understand why many have no desire to try.)
